decisions.reason: As an incremental extension of the firm's laser-marking know-how that remained on the website into 2024, this workstation fits existing capabilities and offers good scope for further refinement through the firm's in-house development and service feedback.

This thermal inkjet printer is close to the firm's core coding business, was still given its own page in 2024, and should benefit from the firm's strong absorptive capacity in adapting printing technologies to customer applications.

The piezo inkjet printer builds directly on established product and application knowledge, and its continued standalone presentation in 2024 suggests enough traction to justify ongoing learning and improvement rather than withdrawal.

Industrial laser marking systems are tightly aligned with the firm's established offer and Industry 4.0 direction, and a 2024 home-page presence indicates strategic importance worth sustaining while the firm scales and learns from market uptake.

The compact laser marking cabin is a related product launched only in 2024, so a capable R&D-led firm would typically keep it on the market long enough to assimilate customer feedback and optimize the offering.

This lubricant printing system extends the firm's high-resolution marking competence into a specialized industrial use case and the trade-fair award is a positive signal that supports continued commercialization and development.
